notes.title: May 2023 - Update 2.7.40 ( Beta/Develop Branch )
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that a new update has been sent to Steam, bringing significant improvements to the game. Here's what you can expect:

Removed 60FPS Limit: The game now offers a smoother and more fluid experience without any FPS restrictions. Enjoy a seamless gameplay experience!

Develop Branch/Beta Access: The update is now available on the Develop branch/beta. Get early access to the latest features and enhancements before they are officially released.

Key Improvements:

Workers' Continuous Activity: Workers will now continue their tasks even during battles in dungeons. This allows for increased productivity and efficiency in managing your resources.

Wider Screen Support: The game now supports wider screens, providing a more immersive and visually captivating experience.

I'm eager for you to try out these enhancements and provide your valuable feedback. Your input has been instrumental in shaping the game's development, and I'm grateful for your ongoing support.

Please update your game to access these exciting features and improvements. If you encounter any issues or have further suggestions, don't hesitate to reach out. Your feedback is essential in making the game even better.

Thank you for your continued support, and happy gaming!

notes.title: Progression Tree Map
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

I'm excited to share with you a Progression Map that I've created for the game. This map contains all the steps necessary for progression, from the start of the game to the finish. Whether you're a new player looking to get started or a seasoned veteran looking to optimize your gameplay, this map is for you! I hope you find it useful and enjoy exploring all the different paths to victory.
